text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: Die, you dog!
source_text: Die, you dog!

text: My defeat shall be avenged!
source_text: My defeat shall be avenged!

text: Hold, initiate! What do you have to report?
source_text: Hold, initiate! What do you have to report?

text: All quiet on the western front.
source_text: All quiet on the western front.

text: Rad Scorpions and intolerable heat. Uh . . . sir.
source_text: Rad Scorpions and intolerable heat. Uh . . . sir.

text: Actually, I wanted to know if you had heard anything.
source_text: Actually, I wanted to know if you had heard anything.

text: Nothing to report, sir!
source_text: Nothing to report, sir!

text: Ruh?
source_text: Ruh?

text: 死吧！你这个狗杂种！
source_text: 死吧！你这个狗杂种！

text: 我会回来报仇的！
source_text: 我会回来报仇的！

text: 立正，新来的，你要报告什么？
source_text: 立正，新来的，你要报告什么？

text: 西墙那边保持安静！
source_text: 西墙那边保持安静！

text: 变种蝎正在猛烈进攻，长官！
source_text: 变种蝎正在猛烈进攻，长官！

text: 我想知道你听见了什么。
source_text: 我想知道你听见了什么。

text: 没什么，长官。
source_text: 没什么，长官。

text: 嗯？
source_text: 嗯？

text: Hold! I recognize you -- you've visited the Brotherhood. Some may trust you,# but I do not. State your business!
source_text:
Hold! I recognize you -- you've visited the Brotherhood. Some may trust you,
# but I do not. State your business!

text: My business is my own, just as yours belongs to you.
source_text: My business is my own, just as yours belongs to you.

text: I wanted to see a friendly face.
source_text: I wanted to see a friendly face.

text: Wandering the wastes, trying to survive.
source_text: Wandering the wastes, trying to survive.

text: I'm killing desert vermin. Do you disapprove?
source_text: I'm killing desert vermin. Do you disapprove?

text: I will only state it to the head of your order. Take me to the Brotherhood.
source_text: I will only state it to the head of your order. Take me to the Brotherhood.

text: Biz?
source_text: Biz?

text: Hold! I recognize you and I do not trust you. I give you fair warning:# if you make trouble for us, you will be shot dead. Now move!
source_text:
Hold! I recognize you and I do not trust you. I give you fair warning:
# if you make trouble for us, you will be shot dead. Now move!

text: Hold! Who goes there! State your name and your business!
source_text: Hold! Who goes there! State your name and your business!

text: I am
source_text: I am

text: 站住！小子，我认出你来了——你来过兄弟会。别人也许会信你，但我不会！老实交待你来这干什么！
source_text: 站住！小子，我认出你来了——你来过兄弟会。别人也许会信你，但我不会！老实交待你来这干什么！

text: 为了我自己的私事，就像你也为了自己的私事。
source_text: 为了我自己的私事，就像你也为了自己的私事。

text: 就不能给我张好脸么。
source_text: 就不能给我张好脸么。

text: 在废土上乱转，混口饭吃罢了。
source_text: 在废土上乱转，混口饭吃罢了。

text: 我去杀沙漠害虫，你不赞成？
source_text: 我去杀沙漠害虫，你不赞成？

text: 这事我只会和你的长官说，快带我去兄弟会。
source_text: 这事我只会和你的长官说，快带我去兄弟会。

text: 生意上的事？
source_text: 生意上的事？

text: 嘿，站住，我认得你这个靠不住的家伙，给你个建议：别惹事，不然我们就把你打成筛子，现在滚吧！
source_text: 嘿，站住，我认得你这个靠不住的家伙，给你个建议：别惹事，不然我们就把你打成筛子，现在滚吧！

text: 谁在那？给我站住，报上你的姓名和职务！
source_text: 谁在那？给我站住，报上你的姓名和职务！

text: 我是
source_text: 我是

text: and I seek a water chip for my Vault. Can you help me?
source_text: and I seek a water chip for my Vault. Can you help me?

text: and I'm trying to find the source of mutant attacks.
source_text: and I'm trying to find the source of mutant attacks.

text: and that's none of your business!
source_text: and that's none of your business!

text: and I'm looking for adventure.
source_text: and I'm looking for adventure.

text: Up yours, soldier boy.
source_text: Up yours, soldier boy.

text: Runk!
source_text: Runk!

text: Halt! These lands belong to the Brotherhood of Steel. Leave now, or we# will shoot you as a trespasser.
source_text:
Halt! These lands belong to the Brotherhood of Steel. Leave now, or we
# will shoot you as a trespasser.

text: Very good. Carry on, Initiate.
source_text: Very good. Carry on, Initiate.

text: I see. Carry on, Initiate.
source_text: I see. Carry on, Initiate.

text: There are reports of large mutant humans attacking travelers, so we're# increasing our vigilance. Keep a close eye on the area and retreat to the# compound if necessary. Initiate, dismissed!
source_text:
There are reports of large mutant humans attacking travelers, so we're
# increasing our vigilance. Keep a close eye on the area and retreat to the
# compound if necessary. Initiate, dismissed!

text: These are troubled times, Initiate! Mutants are on the march, attacking# caravans! We need information, and we need it now! Nothing to report is not# good enough!
source_text:
These are troubled times, Initiate! Mutants are on the march, attacking
# caravans! We need information, and we need it now! Nothing to report is not
# good enough!

text: 我在为我的避难所寻找净水芯片，你能帮帮我吗？
source_text: 我在为我的避难所寻找净水芯片，你能帮帮我吗？

text: 我正在试着找出超级变种人攻击的根源。
source_text: 我正在试着找出超级变种人攻击的根源。

text: 与你无关！
source_text: 与你无关！

text: 我要的就是刺激！
source_text: 我要的就是刺激！

text: 闭嘴，你这个新兵蛋子。
source_text: 闭嘴，你这个新兵蛋子。

text: 别磨叽！
source_text: 别磨叽！

text: 嘿，这是兄弟会的地盘，不赶紧滚的话我就马上把你打成筛子。
source_text: 嘿，这是兄弟会的地盘，不赶紧滚的话我就马上把你打成筛子。

text: 很好，继续吧，新兵。
source_text: 很好，继续吧，新兵。

text: 我知道，继续吧，新兵。
source_text: 我知道，继续吧，新兵。

text: 这里有很多变种人袭击过往商队的报告，所以我们不断在提高警惕。严格巡逻，并在必要时可选择撤退。切记啊，新兵！
source_text: 这里有很多变种人袭击过往商队的报告，所以我们不断在提高警惕。严格巡逻，并在必要时可选择撤退。切记啊，新兵！

text: 有麻烦了，新兵！变种人四处出击，袭击过往商队。我们需要请了解最新战况，现在！没有情报就是最坏的情报！
source_text: 有麻烦了，新兵！变种人四处出击，袭击过往商队。我们需要请了解最新战况，现在！没有情报就是最坏的情报！

text: Get your sorry ass out of here, and bring us back some useful intelligence!# Initiate, dismissed!
source_text:
Get your sorry ass out of here, and bring us back some useful intelligence!
# Initiate, dismissed!

text: Oh yes, I heard about you. Not much of an IQ, but a helluva fighter.# Too bad.
source_text:
Oh yes, I heard about you. Not much of an IQ, but a helluva fighter.
# Too bad.

text: This is our land, and here, your business is our business. I repeat,# state your business.
source_text:
This is our land, and here, your business is our business. I repeat,
# state your business.

text: I seek a water chip for my Vault. Can you help me?
source_text: I seek a water chip for my Vault. Can you help me?

text: I am trying to find the source of mutant attacks.
source_text: I am trying to find the source of mutant attacks.

text: This may be your land, but I am not your slave.
source_text: This may be your land, but I am not your slave.

text: I've been wandering the wastes for a long time. I wanted to know if# you have news.
source_text:
I've been wandering the wastes for a long time. I wanted to know if
# you have news.

text: A friendly face? It won't be mine. I would recommend leaving.
source_text: A friendly face? It won't be mine. I would recommend leaving.

text: As are we all. As long as you do not act against the Brotherhood, you# will not be harmed, but tread carefully.
source_text:
As are we all. As long as you do not act against the Brotherhood, you
# will not be harmed, but tread carefully.

text: It depends on whether or not you consider us vermin. If you attack our# enemies, you will be permitted to travel in our territory. If you offend us,# you will die. Consider yourself warned.
source_text:
It depends on whether or not you consider us vermin. If you attack our
# enemies, you will be permitted to travel in our territory. If you offend us,
# you will die. Consider yourself warned.

text: That's a reasonable request. Fall in.
source_text: That's a reasonable request. Fall in.

text: 带上你的混主意滚，下次带点脑子来，记住了，新兵！
source_text: 带上你的混主意滚，下次带点脑子来，记住了，新兵！

text: 哦，是的，我听说过你。智商不高，却是个呱呱叫的战士，太可惜了。
source_text: 哦，是的，我听说过你。智商不高，却是个呱呱叫的战士，太可惜了。

text: 这是我们的地盘,这里，你的事情就是我们的事情，我再问一次,你来这是干什么的？
source_text: 这是我们的地盘,这里，你的事情就是我们的事情，我再问一次,你来这是干什么的？

text: 我在为我的避难所寻找净水芯片，能帮帮忙吗？
source_text: 我在为我的避难所寻找净水芯片，能帮帮忙吗？

text: 我在寻找变种人出袭的原因。
source_text: 我在寻找变种人出袭的原因。

text: 虽然这是你的地盘，但这可不意味我什么都要听你的。
source_text: 虽然这是你的地盘，但这可不意味我什么都要听你的。

text: 我花了很多时间在废土上乱转。我想从你这打听点情报。
source_text: 我花了很多时间在废土上乱转。我想从你这打听点情报。

text: 一张好脸？有也不是我的，我建议你快离开。
source_text: 一张好脸？有也不是我的，我建议你快离开。

text: 兄弟会面对任何人的态度都是：人不犯我，我不犯人，不过你最好处处小心。
source_text: 兄弟会面对任何人的态度都是：人不犯我，我不犯人，不过你最好处处小心。

text: 这要看你认为我们是不是沙漠害虫。如果敢帮我们去做掉几个敌人，那么就获得了我们管辖区的通行权。如果敢和我们作对，就等着死去吧，何去何从，好好想想吧。
source_text: 这要看你认为我们是不是沙漠害虫。如果敢帮我们去做掉几个敌人，那么就获得了我们管辖区的通行权。如果敢和我们作对，就等着死去吧，何去何从，好好想想吧。

text: 合理的要求，我们成交。
source_text: 合理的要求，我们成交。

text: Water chip? I hope you're not serious! You'd be better off struggling# on the surface than enslaving yourself to a single piece of machinery.
source_text:
Water chip? I hope you're not serious! You'd be better off struggling
# on the surface than enslaving yourself to a single piece of machinery.

text: As are we. The most common theory is that they come from the Glow, but# I doubt even mutants could survive there for long. If you find out# something, let us know.
source_text:
As are we. The most common theory is that they come from the Glow, but
# I doubt even mutants could survive there for long. If you find out
# something, let us know.

text: How dare you accuse me of such a thing! The Brotherhood of Steel has# never forced anyuone to serve us against their will. That goes against everything# we believe in. Get out of my sight!
source_text:
How dare you accuse me of such a thing! The Brotherhood of Steel has
# never forced anyuone to serve us against their will. That goes against everything
# we believe in. Get out of my sight!

text: We found a wrecked caravan about a day's journey to the west. We found# one survivor - poor girl. She claimed they were attacked by mutant humans# with incredible strength.
source_text:
We found a wrecked caravan about a day's journey to the west. We found
# one survivor - poor girl. She claimed they were attacked by mutant humans
# with incredible strength.

text: We've heard enough reports that we're . . . concerned. I would walk# cautiously, if I were you.
source_text:
We've heard enough reports that we're . . . concerned. I would walk
# cautiously, if I were you.

text: I'm going to have to teach you some manners, boy. This should make# for some light entertainment.
source_text:
I'm going to have to teach you some manners, boy. This should make
# for some light entertainment.

text: I'm going to have to teach you some manners, girl. This should make# for some light entertainment.
source_text:
I'm going to have to teach you some manners, girl. This should make
# for some light entertainment.

text: Your mind is completely gone. Poor creature.
source_text: Your mind is completely gone. Poor creature.

text: Stop wasting my time, fool!
source_text: Stop wasting my time, fool!

text: What do you want?
source_text: What do you want?

text: Nothing.
source_text: Nothing.

text: Then I suggest you leave.
source_text: Then I suggest you leave.

text: 净水芯片？你不是开玩笑吧，你最好放弃，否则就象大海捞针，你一辈子就成这一小片机器的奴隶了。
source_text: 净水芯片？你不是开玩笑吧，你最好放弃，否则就象大海捞针，你一辈子就成这一小片机器的奴隶了。

text: 大家都知道是辐射造就了变种人，不过谁也不清楚他们能在那种环境下活多久。如果你了解到什么，不妨和我们说说。
source_text: 大家都知道是辐射造就了变种人，不过谁也不清楚他们能在那种环境下活多久。如果你了解到什么，不妨和我们说说。

text: 你居然敢为了这种事情来麻烦我！兄弟会从不强迫他人违背意愿为我们服务，这与我们的信念相违背，别再让我看见你。
source_text: 你居然敢为了这种事情来麻烦我！兄弟会从不强迫他人违背意愿为我们服务，这与我们的信念相违背，别再让我看见你。

text: 我们在西面离这里几天路的地方发现一个被袭击的商队。还有一名可怜的女孩活着。她说袭击者是一群全副武装的变种人。
source_text: 我们在西面离这里几天路的地方发现一个被袭击的商队。还有一名可怜的女孩活着。她说袭击者是一群全副武装的变种人。

text: 我们听到的报告够多了，现在只能劝你行动的时候处处小心。
source_text: 我们听到的报告够多了，现在只能劝你行动的时候处处小心。

text: 我想我得教导你一些礼节，小伙儿。不过这样也许会闹出些笑话。
source_text: 我想我得教导你一些礼节，小伙儿。不过这样也许会闹出些笑话。

text: 我想我得教导你一些礼节，姑娘。不过这样也许会闹出些笑话。
source_text: 我想我得教导你一些礼节，姑娘。不过这样也许会闹出些笑话。

text: 可怜的家伙，你彻底糊涂了。
source_text: 可怜的家伙，你彻底糊涂了。

text: 别再烦我了，白痴！
source_text: 别再烦我了，白痴！

text: 想要什么？
source_text: 想要什么？

text: 没什么。
source_text: 没什么。

text: 那你最好离开。
source_text: 那你最好离开。
